recipe: 2 epochs head only (lr 1e-3), then full fine-tuning (backbone lr 0.0001, cosine), AdamW, label smoothing 0.05, class×source balanced sampling
preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB, thumbnail max side 320 (LANCZOS), pad to 224x224 gray (127,127,127), ImageNet mean/std
selection: validation macro-F1 only; temperature fitted to validation NLL; test evaluated once
